description: Header file defining a template class 'MaybeOwned' for managing ownership or borrowing of objects, along with associated traits and utility functions.

classes.name: MaybeOwned
classes.description: A smart pointer managing either a borrowed or owned object of type T, supporting copy/move semantics and borrow/ownership guarantees.

classes.name: MaybeOwnedTraits
classes.description: Traits class defining how to borrow from type T.

classes.name: MaybeOwnedTraitsGenericImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of borrowing traits for generic types.

methods.name: MaybeOwned::borrowed
methods.description: Creates a MaybeOwned instance that borrows the given object.

methods.name: MaybeOwned::owned
methods.description: Creates a MaybeOwned instance that owns the given object.

methods.name: MaybeOwned::operator*
methods.description: Dereferences the MaybeOwned to access the underlying object.

methods.name: MaybeOwned::operator->
methods.description: Provides pointer-like access to the underlying object.
